title: Icon reference
description: Shared shape for a block's optional icon value. Extensible via the `type` discriminator on the object branches — add a new `type` value with its own required/optional properties (e.g. `{"type":"custom","assetId":...}` for a custom SVG) as new icon sources are supported, without breaking data saved under the existing branches. QCG-20295: the button block previously inlined this same oneOf directly, with no discriminator — see git history on _base_button.json. The `image` branch below was consolidated from menu_info.json's and social_profile.json's own separately-inlined `{url}` icon shapes — see git history on those files.

oneOf.description: A raw emoji or unicode character, rendered as text.

type.description: Discriminates the icon source. Optional and defaults to "icon" so rows saved before this discriminator existed (bare {name,color}) keep validating without a data migration. Future icon-source branches (image, custom, ...) must declare their own required `type` value and a disjoint property set so `oneOf` can still tell branches apart.

name.description: Icon name from our icon library (see packages/blocks/src/data/block-icons.ts on the frontend).

color.description: Icon color. Empty/absent means use theme default.

type.description: Discriminates the icon source. Optional and defaults to "image" so rows saved before this discriminator existed (bare {url}) keep validating without a data migration.

url.description: URL of an uploaded/external image used as the icon. Absent or empty means no icon set.

oneOf.description: An uploaded or externally-hosted image used as the icon, as opposed to a library icon or emoji. `url` is optional (an icon field with no image set yet is still a valid, empty image reference) — matches the field's frontend editor (kind:"image"), which writes only the `url` sub-path and never a `type` key, relying on this default.
